The Security Manager will be responsible for implementing and overseeing security operationsfor the Mexicali, MX site, ensuring a safe and secure environment for employees, assets, and business operations. The role involves risk assessment, regulatory compliance, executive protection, investigations, emergency response, vendor management, and cross-functional collaboration. The Security Manager will report to the Global Security Director and work closely with site leadership, HR, Legal, EHS, and government agencies.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop, enforce, and continuously improve security strategies to protect employees, facilities, and company assets.

• Conduct risk assessments, identify threats, and implement mitigation measures to reduce security vulnerabilities across all three sites.

• Manage 24/7 security operations, ensuring effective deployment of security personnel and technology.

• Oversee and maintain CCTV, access control, perimeter security, and alarm systems to prevent unauthorized access or incidents.

• Supervise third-party security vendors, ensuring compliance with company policies, performance benchmarks, and contract requirements.

• Ensure the operational readiness and maintenance of all security infrastructure and recommend technology upgrades to enhance site security.

• Support liaison efforts with law enforcement, government agencies (PNP, NBI, Customs, AHJ), and regulatory bodies to assist with security initiatives and compliance requirements.

• Ensure compliance with C-TPAT and global supply chain security standards, conducting internal audits, customer security walkthroughs, and risk mitigation planning.

• Lead and coordinate security investigations related to theft, fraud, workplace violence, and operational breaches, collaborating with HR and Legal as necessary.

• Develop, implement, and test emergency response protocols for incidents such as fire, natural disasters, active shooter situations, and civil unrest.

• Conduct security drills and training programs to ensure crisis preparedness across all sites.

• Act as the point of contact for emergency coordination and escalation.

• Oversee executive protection programs for senior leaders and high-risk personnel as required, ensuring proper security planning and travel risk assessments.

• Support security awareness initiatives and training programs for employees and security personnel to strengthen internal security culture and vigilance.

• Provide on-call emergency response support and travel between sites as needed to coordinate security operations effectively.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

• Bachelor’s Degree in Security Management, Criminology, Law Enforcement, or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience in corporate security, law enforcement, military, or a similar field.

• Strong expertise in risk management, security investigations, executive protection, and emergency response planning.

• Experience in C-TPAT compliance, security audits, and customer security support is highly preferred.

• Proven ability to liaise with law enforcement, government agencies, and regulatory bodies.

• Strong knowledge of security technology solutions, including CCTV, access control, and alarm systems.

• Ability to travel between Laguna, Cavite, and Eastwood sites and provide on-call emergency response support.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

• Office-based role with frequent on-site security inspections.

• Expected to be on-call 24/7 for emergencies, crisis response, and executive protection support.

• Regular coordination with senior management, local law enforcement, and government agencies.

At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.

The Construction Mechanical Engineer makes sure that what is indicated in the electrical drawings is properly built as well as that the materials and equipment are reviewed, approved, manufactured, and delivered on site when required. The process, managed by the Mechanical Engineer, is to help simplify the work in the field and maintain the overall schedule. The Mechanical Engineer will work with the project cost management team to help the Project Manager and DCD PM manage and control all cost-related issues encountered during the construction phase. Qualifications

  • Degrees and/or professional licenses in Mechanical Engineering.

Experience/Skills/Education:

  • 3+ Experience in Data Center implementation Mechanical standards and practices.
  • Good ability to effectively communicate complex technical solutions and concepts to engineers.
  • Experience in use of local Mechanical codes.
  • Construction Health & Safety knowledge.

Program Overview : Chemonics International, a US-based international development consulting firm, seeks a Procurement and Logistics Specialist for the USAID Iraq Together project. Iraq Together aims to provide more equitable, efficient, and sustainable public services in Iraq, as well as improving government responsiveness to citizens’ needs and demands. Objectives of this project include working with the Government of Iraq (GOI) to improve service delivery and strengthen democratic and participatory governance.

Position Overview: The Procurement and Logistics Associate will be responsible for leading the technical and operational procurement processes on Iraq Together, in coordination with the Operations Director and their team. The individual will ensure quality standards are met, and all procurements are cost-effective and compliant with USAID rules and regulations, Chemonics policies and procedures, and Iraqi government laws. This role will oversee the full procurement cycle, including support to the program teams as required, and lead the logistical operations of the project activities and office facilities. This position is open to Iraqi nationals residing in Baghdad, Iraq.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Preserve the integrity of the procurement process, including drafting project procurement documents including all solicitations, negotiation memos, consents to subcontract, and applicable waivers.
  • Maintain organized and concise procurement files that document project compliance with USAID rules and regulations, Chemonics policies and procedures, as well as local, third country, or US government rules that affect the procurement process.
  • Provide guidance to technical and operational staff on procurement/compliance policies, in particular those contained in FAR, CFR, ADS, and AIDAR regulating procurement.
  • Enforce clear and transparent procurement procedures.
  • Work directly with local, regional, or international vendors and service providers to obtain quotations and/or to conduct procurements of commodities or services.
  • Monitor contracts and purchase orders and conduct follow-up as necessary to ensure compliance with terms and conditions.
  • Compile all required documentation to facilitate payment requests.
  • Organize and participate in internal evaluation committees.
  • Monitor for any procurement-related conflict of interest and ensure the project’s procurement process is open and transparent.
  • Work with project leadership to answer any questions or provide USAID with any requested information about project procurements.
  • Other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of procurement, subcontracts and grants required.
  • Experience working for USAID or other donor funded projects strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrable experience and understanding of procurement procedures of international organizations.
  • Strong organizational, management, and administrative skills.
  • Willingness and ability to work efficiently and respectfully with a diverse group of people.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, in particular Excel, Word, SharePoint, and Outlook.
  • Demonstrated leadership, versatility, and integrity.
  • Proficiency in written and oral Arabic and English is required; written and oral fluency in Kurdish, and other local languages is a plus, but not required.

title: Senior Data Engineer Data Solutions
description:
Apply now for a career that puts wellbeing first!

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer for our Data Solutions squad in Brazil !

Join our growing Data team at Wellhub and contribute to our data democratization mission: make data accessible to everyone! We are responsible for empowering all teams by providing a scalable and reliable data platform to collect, organize, and process the deluge of data generated daily at Wellhub, following data modeling and governance best practices. Your work will directly impact our goal of enabling all teams to make data-driven decisions and generate business value from data.

We use data and software engineering principles to solve large-scale production challenges. Our infrastructure is completely in the cloud, running Kubernetes, Trino, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, Flink, and more cutting-edge projects.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Design and implement innovative data solutions that enhance automation, efficiency, and productivity for data practitioners across the organization.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to architect and develop in-house data solutions that meet organizational needs.
  • Lead the evaluation and integration of cutting-edge technologies to optimize our data and machine learning processes.
  • Ensure robust data architecture and technical product integration, enhancing the overall data ecosystem.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Hands-on expertise in data engineering and architecture, with the ability to follow software engineering best practices.
  • Experience in building in-house solutions to address common data engineering patterns.
  • Proficient in CDC, Flink, Spark, Airflow, Trino, and Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of data lakehouse design and technical integration with products.
  • Passionate about data democratization, making data accessible and useful across the organization.
  • Familiarity with data management tools (e.g. OpenMetadata) and/or MLOps frameworks (e.g., Metaflow, Kubeflow).
  • Previous experience in a cloud-based infrastructure, preferably using AWS stack is a plus.
  • Experience with scalable data processing and storage solutions (e.g., S3 Management, Trino, Hive Metastore) is a plus.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that experience working with CDC, Flink, Spark, Airflow, Trino, and Kubernetes, as well as an advanced level of English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and well-being of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. title: Digital System Architech  (d / f / m)
description:
People are at the heart of everything we do at TK Elevator: we work as a team, we care about the safety of others and we share a common vision to keep the world moving. This is your opportunity to go further and impact the future of urban mobility.

We are seeking a Digital Solutions System Architect to lead the high-level design and technical direction of our global elevator digital solutions. This role will oversee the architecture of embedded systems, IoT solutions, and connectivity platforms, ensuring seamless integration, security, and scalability across our next-generation elevator technology. The ideal candidate will be responsible for defining best practices, making key technology decisions, and acting as a technical liaison between teams to drive innovation and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • High-Level System Design: Define the architectural vision and technical roadmap for IoT-enabled digital elevator solutions, ensuring alignment with business and security requirements.
  • Technical Leadership: Guide and mentor development teams in implementing robust, scalable, and maintainable digital solutions.
  • System Architecture Modeling: Create and maintain UML diagrams, system models, and technical documentation to ensure clarity and consistency in system design.
  • Problem Solving & Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve technical challenges, ensuring reliability and performance of digital elevator solutions.
  • Technology & Tooling Decisions: Select appropriate development platforms, frameworks, tools, and environments for digital projects.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as a technical liaison between embedded software teams, security teams, cloud infrastructure teams, and external partners.
  • Security & Compliance: Work closely with security specialists to integrate cybersecurity best practices into all phases of the development lifecycle.
  • Performance Optimization: Ensure that all software and system designs are optimized for performance, efficiency, and scalability.

Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with exceptional GPA.

Experience:

  • 5-7 years experience with computer science or software engineering related project work in embedded development (preferably in projects involving complex systems similar to elevator and escalators).

Technical Skills:

  • Outstanding programming skills with expertise in one or more languages: C, C++, C#, Java, Python.
  • Deep knowledge of UML and system modeling methodologies.
  • Strong background in embedded systems, IoT protocols, and cloud integration.
  • Experience with cybersecurity principles, secure development lifecycle, and compliance standards.
  • Knowledge of real-time operating systems (RTOS), Linux embedded, and microcontroller architectures.
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, RS485, MQTT, and industrial IoT standards.
  • Strong understanding of linear algebra, discrete mathematics, calculus, and statistics.
  • Experience with hardware development and manufacturing processes are desired.
  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and automation frameworks is a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • Outstanding creative thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, able to convey complex ideas to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Exceptional leadership with a collaborative, upbeat personality.
  • Ability to work in a global, cross-functional team environment, managing multiple priorities and adjusting to shifting requirements.

Language:

  • Proficient English communication skills, both written and spoken. Knowledge of additional languages, such as German and/or Spanish, are beneficial.

title: FBA FC Operations Program Manager, FBA - Fullfillment by Amazon
description:
FBA FC Operations Program Manager, FBA - Fulfillment by Amazon

At Amazon Brazil we value Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions, therefore, we act intentionally so that our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we play and the customers we serve. In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity and Inclusion squad, which is formed by representatives from different roles and areas. Our leadership is committed and understands more and more their role in sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of ‘Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer’. Understanding our responsibility and our need for change is essential.


Are you looking for a new challenge in a fast-paced, innovative company? Come make history in Amazon’s Brazil team! Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. Over 2 million Sellers in 10 countries list their products for sale on Amazon. Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices.


We are looking for a Program Manager for Amazon to support FBA (Fulfillment By Amazon) Brazil. This position will be based in an Amazon FC and will support the FBA team to manage its operations. This PM will work closely with various stakeholders (Operations, S&OP, Program, Sales, Operations, Transportation, Legal, etc.) to drive strategic and tactical initiatives to improve FBA operations, including Inbound, Outbound, and Inventory Management. This position will focus on process improvements across teams, identifying areas of opportunities, mapping processes, and proposing optimizations, as well as managing daily operations. He/She will build and own metrics and reports and review performance metrics, being the bridge between FC operations and Business teams.


Key Job Responsibilities

The key responsibilities for this role include:

  1. Act as the link between FC Operations and FBA Business teams
  2. Identify gaps, pain points, and opportunities in the existing processes and propose improvements
  3. Dive Deep on issues to differentiate isolated issues from structural ones
  4. Own metrics and reports, as well as keeping track of key metrics and initiatives impact
  5. Be creative to create solutions that address pain points/opportunities and improve Seller Experience
  6. Calculate impact/potential of ideas/pain points, making it tangible
  7. Influence and support the Product team (both Latam and global teams) on Roadmap prioritization
  8. Suggest/create programmatic solutions and initiatives while creating business cases for the Product team
  9. Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, make trade-offs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints

About the Team

FBA is one key team in Amazon BR. We manage the operations for sellers that send their inventory to our Fulfillment Center (FC) - from collecting their products to delivering them to customers and receiving customers' returns. In FBA, we have several teams that manage SX and operations in this business model. Fulfillment Operations is one of the teams, and we manage the whole inventory once it's received in the FC: Inventory management, removals, customer returns, reimbursements, and operational processes. We are a data-driven team that owns metrics tracking and evolution, maps gaps, and implements improvements to impact our sellers and customers.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of operational and/or retail management experience
- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of driving end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Brand and Creative Designer for Frank & Myra
description:
We are seeking a talented and versatile Brand and Creative Designer to join our growing aromatherapy company, Frank & Myra. The ideal candidate will have a strong passion for creating visually stunning designs that effectively communicate our brand story and values. As the lead designer, you will be responsible for developing and executing a cohesive visual identity across all touchpoints, from packaging to digital media.

Tasks

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Develop and refine Frank & Myra's brand identity, including logo design, color palettes, typography, and visual guidelines.
  2. Design compelling product packaging for our line of essential oils, hydrosols, and resins that balances aesthetics, functionality, and sustainability.
  3. Create marketing collateral such as brochures, flyers, catalogs, and point-of-purchase displays that engage customers and drive sales.
  4. Collaborate with the marketing team to design digital assets, including website graphics, social media visuals, email templates, and online advertisements.
  5. Produce outstanding product photography and lifestyle imagery that showcases our products and resonates with our target audience.
  6. Ensure brand consistency across all design elements and platforms, maintaining the highest standards of quality and attention to detail.
  7. Stay up-to-date with industry trends, consumer preferences, and emerging design technologies to continuously innovate and improve our visual communications.
  8. Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product development, marketing, and operations, to align design strategies with business objectives and timelines.
  9. Manage relationships with external vendors, such as printers and packaging suppliers, to ensure quality control and cost-effectiveness.
  10. Provide creative direction and mentorship to junior designers or freelancers as the company grows.

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in brand identity development and packaging design, preferably in the wellness or beauty industry.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in brand strategy, packaging design, digital media, and photography.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and other relevant design software.
  • Excellent understanding of color theory, typography, composition, and visual hierarchy.
  • Familiarity with printing processes, packaging materials, and sustainable design practices.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Passion for wellness, natural products, and sustainable living.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in Design or a related field.
  • Experience with motion graphics, video editing, or 3D rendering.
  • Knowledge of UI/UX design principles and web design best practices.
  • Familiarity with aromatherapy, essential oils, and natural wellness products.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and desire to grow with a small, mission-driven company.

Benefits

  • Flexible Work Arrangements
  • Professional Development
  • Wellness Initiatives
  • Community Engagement

At Frank & Myra, we are committed to creating exceptional products that promote well-being while adhering to the highest standards of ethics and sustainability. As our Brand and Creative Designer, you will play a crucial role in shaping our visual identity and communicating our values to the world. We offer a supportive, collaborative work environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to make a meaningful impact in the lives of our customers and communities.

To apply, please submit your resume, portfolio, and a cover letter expressing your interest in the position and why you believe you would be a great fit for Frank & Myra. We look forward to reviewing your application and potentially welcoming you to our team

We divide DOTS PD team internally into 4 Product Domains responsible for changing the company vision into an experience-centric one using different approaches. This position is responsible for handling escalated technical issues, providing in-depth troubleshooting, and supporting the overall service delivery process. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, excellent problem-solving skills, and a customer-centric approach.

  • Improved Service Delivery: By efficiently handling escalated technical issues and resolving complex problems, they ensure timely and effective service delivery, increasing customer satisfaction and reducing issues.

  • Innovation: By staying abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, they can identify opportunities for innovation and implement new solutions to improve service delivery and support business goals.
  • Risk Mitigation: By proactively identifying and addressing potential problems, they help minimize business operations risks and protect critical data and systems.
  • Provide Product insights for new features: By understanding the root cause of tickets, this person will feed the product backlog with new development opportunities.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have proven experience in a technical support or service desk role, demonstrating a solid understanding of various operating systems, software applications, and hardware.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

title: Product Mechanical Engineer
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

As a Mechanical Engineer at Tractian, you'll drive the innovation and development of our IIoT solutions. Collaborating across teams, you'll apply your expertise in mechanics and design to create high-performance products that redefine industrial asset management. From concept to execution, your role will shape Tractian's industry-leading technology, ensuring top-tier quality and functionality in every solution we deliver.

Responsibilities

  • Utilize Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software to create detailed models and drawings of components and assemblies.
  • Employ CAE tools and techniques to perform FEA simulations, including Moldflow, Fatigue, Thermal, structural, and Modal Analyses.
  • Analyze simulation results to evaluate product performance, identify potential issues, and recommend design improvements.
  • Collaborate with the design team to optimize product designs for factors such as strength, durability, and thermal performance.
  • Provide guidance on material selection based on specs and test results to enhance product performance and reliability.
  • Design parts for manufacturing (DFM), understand manufacturer capabilities, and have a strong understanding of manufacturing processes, such as machining and plastic injection.
  • Prototype and test mechanical designs to validate performance and functionality, iterating as necessary.
  • Participate in design reviews to provide valuable insights, feedback, and recommendations for continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in mechanical design and engineering, preferably in the technology or manufacturing sector.
  • Strong understanding of CAE software tools, such as ANSYS, SolidWorks Simulation, COMSOL, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of mechanics, materials science, and design principles.
  • Proficiency in Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software, such as SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar tools.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, such as machining and plastic injection.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Reading and writing proficiency in English.

Bonus points

  • Experience with microcasting and sintering.
  • Familiarity with plastic materials.
  • Experience in the IoT or industrial equipment sector is advantageous.
Compensation:
  • Competitive salary and stock options.
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses.
  • 30 days of paid annual leave.
  • Education and courses stipend.
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years.
  • Day off during the week of your birthday.
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance.
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation.
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Apoio ao Planejamento Pedagógico: Auxiliar na elaboração e organização do planejamento anual e semestral, contribuindo com a preparação de materiais e cronogramas.
  • Gestão de Documentação Escolar: Manter atualizados os registros acadêmicos, como listas de presença, planos de aula e relatórios pedagógicos. Organizar e arquivar documentos físicos e digitais de maneira sistemática e acessível.
  • Atendimento ao Público: Facilitar a comunicação entre professores, alunos e pais, respondendo a dúvidas e encaminhando solicitações aos setores apropriados. Participar do atendimento em eventos escolares, auxiliando na recepção e orientação dos participantes.
  • Suporte em Reuniões e Eventos: Organizar a agenda da coordenação pedagógica, agendando e preparando reuniões, palestras e workshops. Auxiliar na logística de eventos escolares, garantindo que todas as necessidades sejam atendidas de forma eficiente.
  • Acompanhamento do Desempenho dos Alunos: Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores de desempenho acadêmico, realizando levantamentos de notas, frequência e outras métricas. Colaborar na identificação de alunos que necessitam de apoio adicional, encaminhando-os para as devidas ações pedagógicas.
  • Apoio na Formação Continuada dos Professores: Auxiliar na organização e logística de treinamentos, workshops e atividades de desenvolvimento profissional para a equipe docente. Preparar materiais de apoio e recursos necessários para as capacitações.
  • Controle de Materiais e Recursos Pedagógicos: Gerenciar o estoque de materiais didáticos e administrativos, solicitando reposições quando necessário. Assegurar que os professores tenham acesso aos recursos necessários para o desenvolvimento de suas atividades.
  • Colaboração em Projetos Pedagógicos: Participar da implementação e acompanhamento de projetos pedagógicos, garantindo que sejam executados conforme o planejado. Auxiliar na avaliação dos resultados dos projetos, propondo melhorias e ajustes quando necessário.
  • Suporte em Processos Administrativos: Auxiliar nas tarefas administrativas diárias, como organização de horários, gestão de substituições e acompanhamento de cronogramas. Colaborar com outros setores da escola para garantir o bom funcionamento das operações pedagógicas e administrativas.
  • Mediação de Conflitos Menores: Auxiliar na resolução de conflitos entre alunos, professores e pais, promovendo um ambiente escolar harmonioso. Encaminhar questões mais complexas para a coordenação pedagógica ou direção escolar.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Formação Acadêmica: Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Pedagogia, Administração Educacional ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência prévia em funções de suporte pedagógico, secretaria escolar ou atividades administrativas no ambiente educacional é desejável. Vivência em atendimento ao público e gestão de documentação escolar.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão escolar e pacotes de software como Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Noções de metodologias de ensino e planejamento pedagógico.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Organização e atenção aos detalhes para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e manter registros precisos. Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir eficazmente com professores, alunos e pais. Proatividade e capacidade de resolver problemas de forma eficiente. Capacidade de Trabalho em Equipe: Habilidade para colaborar com diferentes setores da escola, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho cooperativo. Disposição para apoiar e auxiliar a coordenação pedagógica em todas as suas demandas. Gestão do Tempo: Competência para priorizar tarefas e cumprir prazos estabelecidos, mantendo a eficiência nas atividades diárias. Flexibilidade e Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de se adaptar a mudanças e demandas emergenciais, especialmente durante períodos de matrículas e eventos escolares. Responsabilidade na execução das tarefas atribuídas, garantindo a integridade das operações pedagógicas.

title: Agente de Campo- São Paulo/SP
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:
A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL São Paulo, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O (a) Agente de Campo (a) terá como principal atividade realizar visitas domiciliares para transmissão de informações que contribuam para redução do consumo de energia elétrica e implementação de outras atividades do projeto.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Conceder dicas de consumo consciente que contribuam diretamente para reduzir o desperdício de energia;
  2. Atender demandas comerciais do cliente ou indicar os caminhos para que possam ser solucionadas;
  3. Aplicar o questionário socioeconômico através de sistema online;
  4. Orientação e realização do Cadastramento de clientes na Tarifa Social de Energia Elétrica;
  5. Realizar indicações de clientes para outros projetos de Eficiência Energética;
  6. Identificar potenciais instituições para a execução de outras atividades de Eficiência Energética;
  7. Identificar pessoas de referência e/ou líderes comunitários da localidade e reportar internamente;
  8. Entregar e realizar controle de entrega de atendimentos e serviços comerciais realizados pela equipe;
  9. Efetuar trocas de lâmpadas, conforme necessidade da atuação do agente;
  10. Divulgar os projetos, apoiando em atividades e eventos externos.

Para nós da M. Dias Branco, a qualidade de vida no ambiente de trabalho, bem como, o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores, são considerados fatores primordiais para o sucesso.

Por isso, investimos constantemente em treinamentos e na construção de um clima organizacional favorável ao alcance dos resultados. Estamos sempre em busca de bons profissionais para integrar à nossa equipe nas mais diversas áreas e unidades.

Nossas marcas: Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras, são conhecidas nos mais diversos mercados que atuamos e levam a qualidade da M. Dias Branco para a mesa de milhões de famílias brasileiras. Cada marca ocupa uma posição de destaque em seus mercados, conquistando diversos prêmios em pesquisas junto aos consumidores.

Missão do Cargo:

Desempenhar, sob supervisão, atividades de complexidade restrita, relacionadas a um ou mais dos seguintes processos: remuneração, benefícios, treinamento, desenvolvimento, clima organizacional, recrutamento e seleção de profissionais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seus desafios serão:

Cultura Organizacional

Apoiar a implementação das ações do projeto de evolução cultural da M. Dias Branco.

Engajar lideranças e equipes nas campanhas e comunicações institucionais ligadas à cultura.

Estimular a participação em pesquisas organizacionais, como a de Cultura e Valores.

Clima Organizacional

Protagonizar a execução da Pesquisa de Clima nas unidades, atuando desde o planejamento, liderado pela área especialista, divulgação e comunicação até o suporte a líderes e colaboradores durante o processo.

Apoiar na divulgação dos resultados da pesquisa e no engajamento dos líderes na Plataforma Conexão Clima.

Monitorar a percepção de clima nas unidades e reportar possíveis alertas à área de Gente & Gestão.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Apoiar a execução de eventos e ações institucionais, como a Semana da Diversidade e campanhas temáticas (Ex: Dia da Mulher, Orgulho LGBTQIAPN+, Novembro Negro).

Identificar situações relacionadas a diversidade, equidade e inclusão e reportar à área especialista para tratativas adequadas.

Atuar como agente multiplicador das diretrizes de D&I, promovendo a escuta ativa e o respeito às diferenças.

Saúde Mental

Apoiar a comunicação e adesão ao Programa de Saúde Mental Levemente.

Organizar e facilitar rodas de conversa com colaboradores e lideranças, promovendo espaços de escuta, acolhimento e orientação.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio concluído.
  • Desejável cursando superior em Psicologia, Administração de Empresas, Pedagogia ou áreas correlatas.
  • No mínimo 6 meses de experiência na área ou áreas correlatas.
Informações adicionais

Aqui você encontra:

  • Ambiente de trabalho acolhedor, colaborativo e recheado de oportunidades;
  • Salário compatível com o mercado;
  • Plano de Saúde com possibilidade de incluir dependentes com condições diferenciadas;

Candidato(a), queremos te proporcionar uma ótima experiência no nosso processo seletivo, mas para isso precisamos que você:

title: Art Assistant
description:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, our most valuable asset is our people. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers, and consumers worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage, and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

Our most valuable asset is our people.

At ZS , we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are part of your success here. Learn more about our diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces, obtaining the resources they need to thrive, and sharing the messages they are passionate about.

Assistente de Arte - São Paulo

About Creative & Communications at ZS

Creative & Communications is the full-service creative team powered by ZS—the world’s largest professional services company focused on health. At Creative & Communications, our mission is simple: Imagine the unimagined and make it real for clients and brands brave enough to be first. Additionally, we believe in the real purpose of health brands, see this space as a platform for incredible creativity, storytelling, and innovation. We are continuously in pursuit of doing what hasn’t been done and set out for inspiration every day with a club. If that sounds good to you, then Creative & Communications might be the place for you.

Role Description and Expectation

Valued team member working in the advertising, design, and communications space with an emphasis on global health clients and brands. The Assistente de Arte is a member of our São Paulo-based art and design group and part of a global team (teammates in New York, California, London, and India). The São Paulo art and design group will be focused on creating original design work and executing established designs across a broad range of tactics for US and global brands primarily in the health space. This group will be connected to and working with teams primarily based in the United States. As an Assistente de Arte , your role is multifaceted. You will support the Diretor de Arte/Designer Senior and Diretor de Arte Pleno across a wide variety of projects including layout design; executing new pieces in established styles; contributing graphic design and art direction to projects; updating and incorporating changes to digital, print, and sales tactics (among others); layout design; creating infographics and other data visualizations.

What you will do

  • Support US- and global brands with incredible art direction, graphic design, and by helping brand teams execute a wide variety of tactics according to brand guidelines.
  • Work under the guidance of the Diretor de Arte/Designer and Diretor de Arte Pleno to meet brand and client needs.
  • Learn health industry design regulation and norms.
  • Work within established brand guidelines and health industry regulations to update existing pieces and create new ones based on provided manuscripts.
  • Design and format PowerPoint presentations, create animations, and create templates.
  • Design illustrations, charts, infographics for educational and promotional purposes.
  • Design and produce event materials, both digital and print, including signage, brochures, and web pages.
  • Design new web pages and follow standards of HTML, including images, logos, usability, and accessibility.
  • Provide image retouching, clipping paths, and additional image manipulation.
  • Maintain production files, including fonts, images, logos, and other artwork.
  • Update existing files and layouts to incorporate change.
  • Collaborate closely with art directors, designers, developers, copywriters, and other cross-functional team members.

What you will bring

  • Must demonstrate extremely strong art direction and graphic design skills across a variety of mediums.
  • Must be able to demonstrate effective oral and written English communication skills.
  • Strong typographic and layout skills.
  • Ability to design across a broad range of mediums including print, print sales collateral (brochures, fliers), OOH (poster, signage, etc.), PowerPoint, digital/interactive (website, social, banner ads), digital sales materials (interactive PDFs, Veeva), video graphic elements, email.
  • Design and organize information into coherent, high-impact communications while adhering to established brand guidelines.
  • Skilled working in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator), Veeva, PowerPoint.
  • Knowledge of the latest web and graphic design trends and tools.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work well within a team setting.
  • Interest in incorporating AI tools into work.
  • Advertising and marketing school or coursework.
  • Art school or coursework.
  • Related areas of study.
  • 3+ years of advertising, graphic design, studio, or related work experience.

Perks & Benefits:

ZS offers a comprehensive total rewards package including health and well-being, financial planning, annual leave, personal growth, and professional development. Our robust skills development programs, multiple career progression options, and internal mobility paths and collaborative culture empower you to thrive as an individual and global team member.

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client-facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we're building a diverse and inclusive company where people bring their passions to inspire life-changing impact and deliver better outcomes for all. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job and recognize the value that candidates with all backgrounds, including non-traditional ones, bring. If you are interested in joining us, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements listed above.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

To Complete Your Application:

Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment. An online application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

title: Jardineiro
description:
O cargo de Jardineiro existe para cuidar e manter os espaços verdes de uma empresa, residência, parque ou outro tipo de estabelecimento. Esse profissional é responsável por atividades como o plantio, poda, irrigação, adubação e controle de pragas e doenças das plantas. O jardineiro também deve garantir a limpeza e organização dos jardins, criando ambientes agradáveis e bem cuidados.

A função do jardineiro é fundamental para valorizar esteticamente os espaços externos, contribuir para o bem-estar dos usuários e preservar a biodiversidade local. Além disso, ele pode ser responsável por planejar e implementar paisagismo, ajudando a melhorar a aparência e a funcionalidade dos jardins e áreas externas.

Competências Técnicas

  • Entendimento básico sobre diferentes espécies de plantas, suas necessidades de luz, água e nutrientes.
  • Experiência no uso de ferramentas manuais e elétricas, como cortadores de grama, podadeiras e enxadas.
  • Conhecimento sobre métodos e produtos para controle de pragas e doenças que afetam plantas.
  • Capacidade de executar e sugerir melhorias em projetos de paisagismo.
  • Conhecimento técnico para instalar e manter sistemas de irrigação, ajustando conforme necessário.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Capacidade de observar pequenos detalhes que podem afetar a saúde das plantas e a estética do jardim.
  • Disposição para cuidar das plantas ao longo do tempo, respeitando os ciclos naturais de crescimento.
  • Capacidade de identificar problemas ou necessidades antes que se tornem críticos, como detectar sinais precoces de doenças nas plantas.
  • Habilidade para colaborar com outros profissionais em projetos de paisagismo ou manutenção de grandes áreas verdes.
  • Capacidade de realizar trabalhos físicos, muitas vezes ao ar livre e sob diferentes condições climáticas.

Responsabilidades

  • Plantar, podar, regar e adubar plantas, arbustos e árvores, garantindo o crescimento saudável das espécies.
  • Cortar grama, aparar cercas vivas e remover folhas secas, mantendo a estética e limpeza do ambiente.
  • Aplicar pesticidas e fungicidas naturais quando necessário, seguindo as instruções de segurança, para proteger as plantas.
  • Auxiliar na criação e implementação de projetos de paisagismo, incluindo a disposição de plantas e a instalação de sistemas de irrigação.
  • Manter ferramentas e equipamentos de jardinagem, como cortadores de grama e tesouras, em bom estado de funcionamento.
  • Planejar o cultivo de novas plantas, levando em consideração o tipo de solo, clima e época do ano.
  • Instalar e reparar irrigação manual, garantindo a distribuição adequada de água.
  • Identificar e remover ervas daninhas para evitar a competição por nutrientes com plantas desejadas.

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição em Fortaleza, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.
